Anat Cohen first played jazz in Tel Aviv, in the Jaffa Conservatory’s Dixieland Band. She has established herself in the U.S. as a respected clarinetist, saxophonist, band leader and performer of jazz and world music.
Anat was interviewed via Zoom on September 9, 2021 by Monk Rowe, Director of the Fillius Jazz Archive.

My name is Monk Rowe for the Fillius Jazz Archive and Hamilton College Performing Arts, and I’m very pleased to have Anat Cohen with me this morning, not exactly jazz musicians’ hours, but nonetheless I’m pleased to speak with you.
Same here, Monk, very pleased to be speaking with you.
